mapper.select: SELECT d.id AS definition_id, d.field_key, d.label, d.field_type, d.options_json, d.required, d.position, v.value_text, v.value_number, v.value_date, v.value_bool FROM custom_field_definition d LEFT JOIN custom_field_value v ON v.workspace_id = d.workspace_id AND v.definition_id = d.id AND v.entity_id = #{entityId} WHERE d.workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND d.entity_type = #{entityType} AND d.archived = FALSE ORDER BY d.position, d.id
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO custom_field_value (workspace_id, definition_id, entity_type, entity_id, value_text, value_number, value_date, value_bool) VALUES (#{workspaceId}, #{definitionId}, #{entityType}, #{entityId}, #{valueText}, #{valueNumber}, #{valueDate}, #{valueBool}) AS incoming ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE value_text = incoming.value_text, value_number = incoming.value_number, value_date = incoming.value_date, value_bool = incoming.value_bool
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM custom_field_value WHERE workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND definition_id = #{definitionId} AND entity_id = #{entityId}
DELETE FROM custom_field_value WHERE workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND entity_type = #{entityType} AND entity_id = #{entityId}
